description: Everything Einstein can do through this connector, split into free tools and paid tools with their prices, plus how billing works. Call this when you are not sure which tool fits, or before telling a user something isn't available.
name: list_einstein_capabilities

available.description: False when this call has no data. NOT an error.

billing.description: How paying works: the billing model, how to top up and how to sign in.

free.description: Tools any caller can use with no account and no charge.

paid.description: Tools that need a signed-in Einstein account with credit.

priceUsd.description: USD price per call, or a range when the tool routes to several skills.

reason.description: Why the payload is absent, when `available` is false.

title: List Einstein Capabilities
